metadata.title: The Whisper Coin Accord
metadata.premise: In the modern city of Duskmere, carved into rival night courts, a small brass token called the Whisper Coin has resurfaced — and the Ashen, Hollow, and Ember Courts all want it back quietly, before the century's Renewal Night decides who casts the deciding vote over the dark.
metadata.narrationVoice: A noir-tinged second-person narrator, atmospheric and wry, treating gothic horror as ordinary municipal business.

contentLimits.note: Keep threats aimed at adults; any mention of children stays entirely off-screen and undepicted.

beats.title: A Sealed Data-Chit
beats.prose: Duskmere never truly sleeps; it just changes shift. At 12:14 a.m. a courier drone drops a sealed data-chit at your door — no sender, just three coordinates and one line: 'Something small has gone missing. Everyone wants it back quietly.' You're a Nightbroker, one of the few mortals trusted to walk between the city's rival night courts without a leash. The coordinates touch Ashen, Hollow, and Ember ground alike.
beats.readAloud: The chit hums warm in your palm. Three doors, three courts, one missing thing. Pick where the night begins.

options.label: Head into Ashen territory, the old cathedral district
Slip into the Hollow Court's night market under the highway
Visit the Ember Court's archive tower downtown

beats.title: The Deconsecrated Cathedral
beats.prose: The Ashen Court holds court in a deconsecrated cathedral, its stained glass swapped for two-way mirrors. Lady Mireille Voss, centuries dead and immaculately dressed, receives you between sips of something that isn't wine. She admits, with practiced reluctance, that a small brass token — the Whisper Coin — has vanished from the vault beneath the nave, and she'd very much like it found before Renewal Night. She won't say why she needs it so badly.

options.label: Press her on why the coin matters so much
Offer to recover it exclusively for the Ashen Court
Take the job without asking more, and leave

beats.title: The Market Under the Highway
beats.prose: Beneath the elevated highway, strings of fairy lights and stranger lanterns illuminate stalls selling things that shouldn't be for sale. Thistle Wrenshaw, an exile with too many teeth and a salesman's smile, trades in secrets. For the price of your attention, she confirms the Whisper Coin is real, and that the Hollow Court wants it before Ashen or Ember do.

options.label: Haggle for the coin's true purpose
Trade a future favor for the Hollow Court's backing
Buy nothing, just listen to the market's rumors

beats.title: The Archive Tower
beats.prose: The Ember Court's archive tower smells of scorched paper and old contracts. Cassian Rook, archivist and broker of debts, keeps the city's founding treaty — the Concord — under glass. He lets slip that the Whisper Coin was minted as the Concord's tie-breaker: whoever presents it at the Renewal casts the deciding vote. He offers you the restricted stacks, for a price.

options.label: Bribe Cassian for the Ember Court's confidence
Read the sealed treaty pages yourself
Take only what he's given and go

beats.title: Alarm in the Stacks
beats.prose: Alarm wards flare violet as you're caught among the restricted stacks. Animated wardens — bound skeletal clerks, quill-quick and merciless — converge to eject you by force. You just need to break free, not win a war.

beats.title: The Same Small Thing
beats.prose: Piece by piece, the truth comes together: all three courts want the same small thing, for the same reason, on the same night. The Whisper Coin isn't a treasure — it's a vote. Whoever holds it at the Assembly's Renewal decides who rules Duskmere's dark for the next century. It vanished from the Ashen vault days ago and hasn't surfaced in any court's hands. One name keeps coming up: an old fence called Sable, who deals in things nobody else will touch.

options.label: Go find Old Sable, the relic-keeper
Call in a favor from the court you've allied with
Skip the middleman and head straight for the old Clocktower Sanctuary

beats.title: Old Sable's Pawnshop
beats.prose: Old Sable operates a pawnshop that only opens after 2 a.m., surrounded by things too strange to fence anywhere else. She confirms the coin passed through her hands once — sold to no one, because someone stole it back before the deal closed. She believes it's hidden in the Clocktower Sanctuary, the one patch of ground all three courts swore never to touch.

options.label: Pay Sable's price for a way past the Sanctuary's wards
Trade her a secret you learned from your court contact
Refuse to pay and find your own way in

beats.title: The Frozen Face
beats.prose: The Clocktower Sanctuary looms at the city's dead center, its face frozen at a time no one remembers. Old wards — older than any of the three courts — still guard the threshold, indifferent to Ashen, Hollow, or Ember politics alike.

options.label: Carefully disarm the old wards
Use the shortcut you were given
Force the gate open and deal with the consequences

beats.title: The Sanctuary Wakes
beats.prose: The Sanctuary's guardians wake at once — ghoulish keepers bound to the old stones long before any night court existed, alongside the animated bones of those who tried this before you.

beats.title: A Coin of Black Glass
beats.prose: At the Sanctuary's heart, past a century of dust, the Whisper Coin waits on a plinth of black glass — smaller and plainer than all the fuss suggests. A thin brass disc, warm to the touch, humming faintly with the weight of a hundred years of quiet elections.

options.label: Take the coin and leave immediately
Study the coin's binding before you move
Leave the coin where it lies and walk away from all three courts

beats.title: The Assembly Hall
beats.prose: Renewal Night arrives at the Assembly Hall, a converted opera house where Ashen, Hollow, and Ember delegates sit in uneasy rows beneath chandeliers of bone, bramble, and brass. The Whisper Coin sits warm in your pocket. All eyes turn to the Nightbroker. Whoever you hand it to will cast Duskmere's deciding vote for the next hundred years.

options.label: Present the coin to the Ashen Court
Present the coin to the Hollow Court
Present the coin to the Ember Court

beats.title: A Colder Century
beats.prose: Lady Voss rises as the Assembly murmurs. With the Whisper Coin in Ashen hands, the Concord tilts toward the old dead nobility for a century more. Duskmere grows colder, stricter, and stranger under Ashen law — but it holds, and you're paid in favors that will outlast you. You've made history, whether or not history thanks you for it.

beats.title: A Wilder Duskmere
beats.prose: Thistle Wrenshaw laughs like breaking glass as the Hollow Court claims the vote. The old bindings that kept the fey-exiles leashed to the city's edges finally loosen. Duskmere grows wilder, greener, less predictable — and considerably more dangerous after dark. You helped write the next hundred years in green ink, for better or worse.

beats.title: A City of Contracts
beats.prose: Cassian Rook accepts the coin with the calm of a man collecting on an old debt. The Ember Court's contracts now bind every corner of Duskmere's night economy. The city runs smoother, meaner, and entirely on Ember's terms. Walking home at dawn, you wonder exactly what you just signed the whole city up for.

beats.title: An Unresolved Balance
beats.prose: You leave the coin humming on its black glass plinth and walk out of the Clocktower Sanctuary without it. Renewal Night comes and goes without a deciding vote; the courts remain locked in their uneasy, unresolved balance — brittle, but unbroken. Duskmere keeps its secrets a little longer, and so, mostly, do you.

beats.title: A Very Long Debt
beats.prose: You don't walk away from this one. Whichever guardians caught you, they don't forget a Nightbroker who overreached. You wake in a windowless room with a new mark on your wrist and a very long debt to work off. Duskmere goes on deciding its own fate — without you.
